import time

print("数据库中的表:")
cursor.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';")
tables = cursor.fetchall()
print(tables)

print("\n检查sales_records表的结构:")
cursor.execute("PRAGMA table_info(sales_records)")
columns = cursor.fetchall()
for col in columns:
    print(col)

# 检查数据量
print("\n检查sales_records表的行数:")
cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_records")
row_count = cursor.fetchone()[0]

# 由于计算所有878,503行的笛卡尔积会非常大，我们需要使用更高效的方法

cursor.execute("""
    SELECT 
        MIN("Sales volume (kg)") as min_sales,
        MAX("Sales volume (kg)") as max_sales,
        AVG("Sales volume (kg)") as avg_sales,
        MIN("Unit price (yuan/kg)") as min_price,
        MAX("Unit price (yuan/kg)") as max_price,
        AVG("Unit price (yuan/kg)") as avg_price
    FROM sales_records
""")
stats = cursor.fetchone()
print(f"销售数量统计: 最小值={stats[0]}, 最大值={stats[1]}, 平均值={stats[2]}")
print(f"单价统计: 最小值={stats[3]}, 最大值={stats[4]}, 平均值={stats[5]}")

    FROM sales_records 
    LIMIT 1000
""")

sample_distances = []
for i in range(len(sample_data)):

        dist = abs(sample_data[i][1] - sample_data[j][1]) + abs(sample_data[i][2] - sample_data[j][2])
        sample_distances.append(dist)

# 计算样本距离的中间值
sample_median = np.median(sample_distances) if sample_distances else 0
print(f"基于1000行样本数据的距离中间值: {sample_median}")

# 现在执行完整的查询来获取距离低于中间值的记录对

SELECT a.ROWID, b.ROWID,

FROM sales_records a, sales_records b
WHERE a.ROWID < b.ROWID AND distance < {sample_median}
LIMIT 1000
"""

        SELECT ROWID, "Sales volume (kg)", "Unit price (yuan/kg)"

    ) a

    ) b

print(f"  平均值: {np.mean(distances):.4f}" if distances else "  平均值: N/A")

# 保存结果到CSV文件

print(f"\n总执行时间: {end_time - start_time:.2f} 秒")
